user.title: Connect The Wash Guide
user.description: In The Wash Guide app, open Settings, find Smart home, and tap Generate connect key. Paste the key here. The control key is optional: it lets Home Assistant act as well as read (post a task, ask the house for a maintenance wash, log a clean), and it needs PRO. You can add it later.

error.not_control_key: That is a connect key, not a control key. Connect keys can only read. Generate a control key in the app (it needs PRO) and paste that one here.

init.title: The Wash Guide
init.description:
A control key lets Home Assistant act as well as read: post a task to the household board, ask the house for a maintenance wash, and record the clean when the cycle finishes. Generate one in the app under Settings, Smart home; it needs PRO. Leave the box empty to take the ability to act away again, and reading carries on as before.

The poll interval follows your plan by default: every minute for a PRO household, every 15 minutes otherwise. Set a number of minutes to poll less often than that; it can never poll more often than your plan allows.

If the washing machine sits on a metering smart plug (or reports power itself), pick that power sensor and The Wash Guide will notice cycles from the power curve: when one finishes, a thewashguide_cycle_finished event fires locally and a small summary (start, end, energy) joins your household's record. Detection happens entirely in your home; raw power readings are never sent anywhere. Monitoring only: if the plug can switch, this integration never touches the switch. Clear the picker to turn it off.
